title: Beamed stem lengths — the shortest stem per level
description: Beamed groups whose outer heads span a third, a fifth and an octave, one, two and three beams deep, with one down-stem octave at each of the first two depths. Pins the beam-geometry rule (roadmap: core-beam-geometry): the stem that would come out shortest lands on the per-level minimum — 2.5 spaces under one beam, 3 under two, 3.5 under three — and every other stem grows from there; the slant follows the outer heads within its cap; and the primary beam then nudges outward until it sits on, straddles or hangs from a staff line. Bar 1: eighths, a third then a fifth. Bar 2: eighths, an octave up-stem then an octave down-stem. Bar 3: sixteenths, third / fifth / octave / octave down-stem, one group per beat. Bar 4: thirty-seconds, a third then an octave, then a half rest.
